summary: Recent discussions in Spark focus on extending UDF support through a language‑agnostic protocol, improving catalog handling with a fallback resolver, and optimizing joins via an external lookup approach. A trial of AI‑driven code review has also been introduced for new pull requests. These threads illustrate ongoing efforts to broaden interoperability, simplify configuration, and enhance performance.

highlights.text: Language‑agnostic UDF protocol (SPIP) to enable consistent UDF execution outside Spark via IPC

sources.title: SPIP: Language-agnostic UDF Protocol for Spark

highlights.text: Optional fallback resolver for unknown V2 catalog names to simplify catalog configuration

sources.title: [DISCUSS][SQL] SPARK-59849: Fallback resolver for unknown V2 catalog names

highlights.text: External Lookup Join that performs on‑demand lookups against a static side to reduce latency
Trial of automated AI code review using Claude for new Spark pull requests, posting advisory comments only

sources.title: [DISCUSS] Automated AI code review on new Spark PRs (trial)
